aboutHtml:
We're Tony McLaren's STIHL shop in Morrinsville. We stock chainsaws, trimmers, lawnmowers, and parts for home gardens through to larger properties. Whether you're looking for new equipment or need to get your gear serviced, we're the people to see.

We stand behind what we sell. Our workshop handles service and repair, and we keep genuine STIHL parts in stock. Bring your equipment in and we'll get it working properly again. We give honest, practical advice on what works for your place.

Pop in and see us. We're open Monday to Friday 8 to 5, and weekends 9 to 3. You'll find us friendly, knowledgeable, and ready to help.
